cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake at chest height; A habitat food lab with a small tea station and a bright reading panel above a drawer of spare filters — She draws the intact mesh filter out of a broken tea infuser to reuse it in a clean metal frame; A transparent observation bay beside an orbital hydrotherapy pool — She checks whether one fin has a worn hinge after swimming; a night observatory under an open dome — standing; a convention photo zone under ring lights — loops the strap of a camera over her head; her living room with a deep sofa — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — kneeling on the ground; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; a resort cabana with a shaded daybed by the water — sitting on the ground; a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — perched on a ledge or edge; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — hangs a small hand lantern on a hook above her; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — standing
